desc:
Welcome to 99 nights story 2... the sequel.

After your first 99 nights in the forest, some things were left unfinished... you are going back to make sure you handle all your unfinished business, for good.

🎁 Join the ChainLemonade Studios group for a free in-game PET! 🎁

🔊 Play with the sound up for the best experience! 🔊

✨ Can you get all TWO endings? Play again to win both badges! ✨

👍 Be sure to like and favorite this game if you enjoyed it! ⭐

🛒 Struggling to survive? Check out the store for some helpful perks to help you survive! 🛒
